newsitem.title: USA: Medusa expects bigger 1997 cement shipments.
newsitem.headline: Medusa expects bigger 1997 cement shipments.

text.p: Medusa Corp said Monday its net income for the first quarter of 1997 had jumped 54 percent from the same period last year, helping lift earnings per share to $0.11 from $0.07.

The cement producer reported net income of $1.8 million, up from $1.2 million in 1996's first quarter, with consolidated net sales for the quarter increasing 26 percent to $56.8 million, a record level for the quarter.
Medusa said it was optimistic its cement plants will continue to operate at practical capacity for the rest of 1997.

The company said it expects that strong demand seen in the first quarter will moderate, but added it was confident its cement shipments for the year will exceed 1996 levels and that market conditions will remain favorable in 1997.
